output.risk_rationale: BINANCE FRANCE SAS is active in the French registry and has two current officers identified there, while the entity and those officers returned no exact-name/identifier matches in the OFAC, UK OFSI or EU consolidated-list searches. GLEIF identifies the exact legal entity and LEI 969500IHGTBN0TLO0129, but reports the LEI entity as ACTIVE while the LEI registration status is LAPSED, which is a material KYC data-quality concern. No beneficial-owner record, PEP evidence or entity-resolved adverse-media finding was available in the reviewed sources; three group/platform-level reports (the 2023 U.S. DOJ criminal resolution, the 2023 U.S. Treasury/OFAC settlement, and a 2025 report of a French Binance investigation) were excluded because they did not identify SIREN 905060109. On the available evidence, the active registry status and clean sanctions checks support neither high risk nor low risk because beneficial ownership is unverified and the LEI is lapsed.
